title: Save for near-term goals (1–5 years)
summary: Same logic as W-2. Vehicle replacement, home down payment, equipment purchases.
detailsHtml:
Equipment purchases as a tax lever

Business equipment purchases over a few hundred dollars typically can be either depreciated over multiple years or fully expensed in year of purchase (Section 179 or bonus depreciation, depending on the year and rules). In a high-income year, accelerating equipment purchases into Q4 can materially reduce that year's tax burden. Coordinate large purchases with your tax planning.
